EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE DELFT PRADESHIYA SABHAUNDER SECTION 66A(1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member in 03- Delft 03 of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death;

And whereas the Secretary of the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi, the recognized political party to which Mr. ShanmugamLogeswaran the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) (a) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decideupon the member of that 03 - Delft 03 of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualifide underSection 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty(30) days ;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision to nominateRasalingam Parameswary to fill such vacancy ;

Now therefore I, Thanabalasingam Akilan, Returning Officer of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section66A(1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Rasalingam Parameswary waselected as the member of the 03- Delft 03 of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha.
